What to look for: b.y is never assigned, so `b` is only half initialized.

  FXC   rejects it:  error X4000: variable 'b' used without having been
        completely initialized.
  DXC   exits 0 with no diagnostic at all, and emits  i32 undef  as the first
        operand of IMad. Search the DXIL output for "undef".
  Clang emits the identical undef and also says nothing.

So the predecessor compiler diagnosed this and neither successor does.

Restated as a compute shader so all three compilers can run the same source;
the issue's original repro is a vs_6_2 and behaves the same way.
